title: Related-Key Active-S-Box Bounds for MIDORI, PRESENT, and TWINE
summary: No related-key differential active-S-box bounds are known for MIDORI, PRESENT, or TWINE; establishing provable bounds for each remains open.

formal_statement.body: For each of $\mathsf{MIDORI}$, $\mathsf{PRESENT}$, and $\mathsf{TWINE}$, establish provable bounds on the number of active S-boxes in differential characteristics under the related-key model; no related-key bounds are currently known for any of the three designs.

scope.domain: Related-key differential cryptanalysis of MIDORI, PRESENT, and TWINE.
assumptions: Differential characteristics are considered under the related-key model.
parameters: Number of active S-boxes: the quantity for which provable bounds are sought
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish provable related-key bounds on the number of active S-boxes for each of MIDORI, PRESENT, and TWINE.

citations.label: The SKINNY Family of Block Ciphers and Its Low-Latency Variant MANTIS

progress.summary: In its comparison of differential bounds, the source reports that no related-key bounds are known for MIDORI, PRESENT, or TWINE, leaving their active-S-box analyses open.
citation_labels: Christof Beierle et al., The SKINNY Family of Block Ciphers and Its Low-Latency Variant MANTIS
